description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for about 45,000 workforce users at peak, including about 11,500 seasonal farm workers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division application, the FMIS web console, and cloud administration federate to SYS-G1; without sign-in, ROC operators, plant supervisors, and branch staff cannot reach their applications
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; ROC HMIs keep local operator accounts for running irrigation
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; the legacy farm operations directory (ROC SCADA, 2024 acquired farms) is not yet federated (P02)

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Hub network, guardrails, keys, logging, and backup vault in providers A and B
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The farm data hub, the traceability system, ERP servers, e-commerce, and the Grower Agronomy Portal all run behind the hubs
manual_workaround: Provider B workloads (the portal) keep running if provider A hubs fail
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Farm data hub (Crop Farming); traceability (Food Processing); e-commerce and portal (Farm Supply); ERP (all)

description: Links to 38 farm operations, 3 regional irrigation operations centers (ROCs), 11 food facilities, 120 branches, and 4 distribution centers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: ROC SCADA, plant MES, and branch POS depend on site links; the FMIS and portal are reached over the internet
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at ROCs, plants, and branches; pivot panels use a carrier private network independent of the WAN
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions; the farm data hub to ROC link is also the main cyber path into farm OT (P01 CF-004)

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, passive OT monitoring (11 food facilities and 9 of 38 farms), and incident handling
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks (Form 8-K Item 1.05, state breach laws, buyer 24-hour terms, cooperative 72-hour terms) keep running during an outage; OT blind spots at 29 farms already limit detection
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM, EDR, and OT monitoring vendors; forensic retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts; division liaisons; OT security managers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and breach facts (P08)

description: Schedules, setpoints, and remote commands for about 1,150 pivots, 410 well pumps, 6,800 drip-zone valves, and overhead freeze protection on about 4,200 acres of strawberries, run from 3 ROCs
process_owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: In freeze season (about December to February) a lost night can destroy much of a strawberry crop worth about $310 million a season; outside freeze season the MTD is about 24 hours (crop water stress). Workers near pivots and pumps must not face unexpected starts
manual_workaround: Hand-Off-Auto switches at pumps and pivots; freeze-night crews start overhead systems by hand at ROC-1 farms (not written down at the 14 acquired farms)
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 ROC SCADA and FMIS irrigation module; field OT; SYS-G4 not needed
dependent_third_parties: FMIS vendor; irrigation integrator (acquired farms); cellular carrier private network
dependent_people_or_facilities: ROC operators (24x7 in freeze season); irrigation technicians at 38 farms; ROC-1 to ROC-3
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 for FMIS sign-in; WAN to ROCs; farm data hub on SYS-G3 (telemetry only, not needed to run irrigation)

description: Refrigeration controls for 2 frozen vegetable plants (about 48,000 lb and 61,000 lb of anhydrous ammonia) and coolers at all facilities
process_owner: Food Processing plant OT security manager
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Worker and community safety (EPA RMP and OSHA PSM processes); frozen inventory loss; release reporting duties (P08)
manual_workaround: Licensed refrigeration operators run the system locally at the panels; contractor support on site
dependent_third_parties: Refrigeration contractor (remote support through group PAM)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group PAM (SYS-G1) for contractor remote access; group SOC OT monitoring

description: Manufacturing execution and plant OT for wash, sorting, blanching, freezing, roasting, and packaging lines at 7 plants and 4 packinghouses
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $29 million revenue per day; inbound produce is perishable; lines cannot run without validated process controls
manual_workaround: Run lines in local control with paper monitoring records where the food safety plan allows; otherwise hold raw product in coolers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Inbound produce and harvest lot data from Crop Farming (BP-CF04)

business_process: Cold chain monitoring at farm packing sheds and field coolers
description: Temperature monitoring and alarms at 22 farms
process_owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Strawberries and leafy greens lose value within hours above temperature; temperature records support buyer claims
manual_workaround: Hourly manual temperature checks and paper logs
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 field OT (temperature sensors) and FMIS alarms
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Food Processing packinghouses receive cooled product (BP-FP01)

business_process: Food safety and food defense monitoring records
description: Monitoring, corrective action, and verification records that the food safety plans (21 CFR 117) and food defense plans (21 CFR 121) rely on
process_owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be created concurrently (117.305(d); 121.305(d)); product without monitoring records cannot be released
manual_workaround: Paper monitoring forms; hold and test product
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 quality and food safety records; food defense plan repository
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond SYS-G1 and WAN

business_process: Harvest tally, labor, and H-2A earnings records
description: Piece-rate tally, hours offered and worked, and crew records on about 3,400 harvest tablets, exported to payroll
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field tally is part of the H-2A earnings record (20 CFR 655.122(j)(1)); earnings statements are due on or before each payday (655.122(k)); about 9,000 H-2A workers in season
manual_workaround: Paper tally cards keyed within 48 hours; repeat prior payroll then correct
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 FMIS mobile app; harvest tablets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payroll tally export to SYS-G4 through the farm data hub (BP-G06)

description: Lot codes, field and harvest date, cooling and shipping records for produce and peanuts sold to outside buyers and to Food Processing
process_owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Buyer agreements require notice within 24 hours of any event affecting product safety, lot traceability, or committed volumes; Food Processing needs lot data to receive product
manual_workaround: Paper bills of lading and lot tags; lot list emailed from the farm office
dependent_people_or_facilities: Farm shipping offices; 22 packing sheds and field coolers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Nightly harvest lot file from the farm data hub to the Food Processing traceability system (BP-FP04)

description: One-up and one-down lot records linking grower lots to shipped product
process_owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be made available to FDA within 24 hours of an official request (21 CFR 1.361); recalls depend on lot links
manual_workaround: Lot lists rebuilt from paper receiving tags and bills of lading
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 traceability system (on SYS-G3 provider A)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Nightly harvest lot file from the Crop Farming farm data hub (BP-CF04); outside grower lot data

description: Warehouse management, order picking, and shipping for retail, foodservice, and USDA commodity customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer agreements require notice within 24 hours of events affecting product safety or supply; fresh-cut shelf life is days
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists and bills of lading; prioritize fresh-cut
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Order data from SYS-G4 ERP (BP-G05)

business_process: Distribution center warehouse management and delivery
description: Picking and delivery from 4 distribution centers to branches and farms
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Planting and spraying windows; Crop Farming depends on timely inputs
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists for priority orders
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Delivers inputs to Crop Farming farms (BP-CF02)

business_process: Branch ordering and point of sale
description: Counter sales, on-account orders, and card payments at 120 branches (the card data environment)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $13 million revenue per day, concentrated in planting season; growers cannot wait for inputs in application windows
manual_workaround: Offline sales on account with paper tickets; card payments paused
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1; WAN; ERP pricing and credit limits (BP-G05)

description: Multi-tenant service for about 8,200 grower accounts, including 22 reselling cooperatives and their about 5,400 growers
process_owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cooperatives resell the service; prescriptions are needed in application windows; terms commit to incident notice within 72 hours
manual_workaround: Agronomists email prescriptions from desktop tools
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 for staff; SYS-G2 monitoring; provider B landing zone

description: Orders, invoicing, payables, grower settlements, and inventory for all divisions (SYS-G4 on cloud IaaS)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoicing and payments can lag a day or two; plants and branches ship on paper meanwhile
manual_workaround: Paper bills of lading and tickets; manual payment runs for critical suppliers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Food Processing shipping (BP-FP05), Farm Supply sales (BP-FS01), grower settlement (BP-FP06), credit (BP-FS05)

description: Injection rates and schedules for 96 fertigation systems
process_owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stopping injection is the safe state and costs little for a few days; integrity matters far more than availability (wrong rates can harm crops, water, and workers; see P02)
manual_workaround: Injection off and valves closed; manual injection at the skid by a trained operator
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Farm Supply delivers fertigation inputs; integrity monitoring by the group SOC only at 9 farms

business_process: Produce Safety, field, and pesticide application records
description: Produce Safety records (21 CFR 112 Subpart O), pesticide application and hazard information (40 CFR 170.311), crop plans, and application records
process_owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be created when the activity happens (112.161(a)(2)) and be available to FDA within 24 hours if kept offsite (112.166(a)); application information must be displayed and retained (170.311(b))
manual_workaround: Paper forms in farm binders; printed application display at each farm
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond SYS-G1 sign-in

description: Blending plant controllers at 2 plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wrong blends harm crops and customer trust; plants can pause
manual_workaround: Pause blending; ship stock product
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond WAN and SOC

description: Online ordering and card payments for growers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Online share of sales is growing; branches can take orders
manual_workaround: Phone and branch ordering
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 hosting; ERP (BP-G05)

description: Receiving, grading, and settlement for about 260 outside growers and Crop Farming
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Grower payments on contract schedules; receiving continues on paper
manual_workaround: Paper grade tickets; settle later
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Crop Farming lot data (BP-CF04); ERP payables (BP-G05)

business_process: Precision equipment guidance and drone operations
description: GNSS guidance with RTK base stations, equipment telematics, imaging drones, and spray drones
process_owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Planting and spraying windows; manual steering is slower but safe
manual_workaround: Manual steering; ground spraying; postpone flights
dependent_third_parties: Equipment dealers; drone fleet software vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Imagery to the imagery store on SYS-G3 (BP-CF08)

business_process: Payroll and HR, including H-2A records
description: Time, payroll, onboarding, and H-2A documents (passport and visa data, home-country addresses) in the HR and payroll SaaS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly payroll; H-2A earnings statements on or before each payday (20 CFR 655.122(k)); terminations drive access removal
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll, then correct from paper tally
dependent_third_parties: Payroll SaaS vendor; H-2A filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payroll tally from Crop Farming (BP-CF03); termination events feed SYS-G1

description: Trade credit applications (including Social Security numbers and personal guarantees for about 12,000 individual growers), limits, and collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Credit holds can wait a few days; data protection matters more than availability
manual_workaround: Manual credit holds and approvals by the credit director
dependent_systems: SYS-G4 ERP credit module; credit file share
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: ERP (BP-G05)

description: Close, consolidation, growing-crop estimates, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and all divisions; uses yield estimates (BP-CF08)

description: Weekly computer-vision yield estimates from drone orthomosaics
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly cycle; planners can use hand counts and last week estimates
manual_workaround: Hand counts on sample plots
dependent_systems: Imagery store and model service on SYS-G3
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds forward sales, Food Processing production plans, and growing-crop estimates (P10)
